title: Telos: start with the end (BASED, then SMART)
purpose: Help the owner state the end the venture exists for, how anyone would know, what the owners intend then, and what must be true to leave each phase. A framework for thinking over canonical goals and exit criteria (EE-023; Torian, 2026-10-30).

vocabulary.telos: the end a thing exists for: a goal of kind venture
vocabulary.end state: what is true in the world when the end is reached: the venture goal's end_state
vocabulary.measure: how anyone would know, made SMART: a goal measure with a target
vocabulary.owner outcome: what the owners intend once the end is reached: a goal of kind owner
vocabulary.exit criterion: what must be true to leave a phase: a canonical exit criterion serving a measure
vocabulary.BASED: Big, Aspirational, Stretching, Enduring, Directional: the test for the statement
vocabulary.SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound: the test for each measure

frames.question: What is the venture for when it has done its job? (BASED)
What is true in the world when the end is reached?
How would anyone know it was reached? Make each measure SMART.
What do the owners intend to happen then: hold, sell, list or wind down?
For this phase, what must be true to leave it, and which measure does each serve?

maps_to.note: one record per phase, id = phase
